text: Resentment is like drinking poison and waiting for the other person to die.
author: Hayden Panettiere

text: The secret of change is to focus all of your energy, not on fighting the old, but on building the new.
author: Dan Millman

text: Finite players play to be better than others. Infinite players play to be better than themselves. You are your competition.
author: Simon Sinek

text: I used to write to be read; now I write to understand.
author: Mikael Cho

text: Some people want it to happen, some wish it would happen, others make it happen.
author: attributed to Michael Jordan (unverified)

text: Instead of wondering when your next vacation is, maybe you should set up a life you don’t need to escape from.
author: Seth Godin

text: Unconditional happiness is the highest technique there is.
author: Michael A. Singer

text: No one limits your growth but you. If you want to earn more, learn more.
author: Tom Hopkins

text: Creativity is a million tiny acts of daily practice that, with strategy and discipline, can add up to stunning, life-altering accomplishments.
author: Sasha Eng Williams

text: Enlightenment is the quiet acceptance of what is.
author: Wayne Dyer

text: What you will get wrong is that you will not pay enough attention to your users.
author: Paul Graham

text: Sometimes fear does not subside and one must choose to do it afraid.
author: Elisabeth Elliot

text: Surround yourself with relentless humans. People who plan in decades, but live in moments. Train like savages, but create like artists. Obsess in work, relax in life. People who know this is finite, and choose to play infinite games. Find people scaling mountains. Climb together.
author: Zack Pogrob

text: The questions you ask yourself will largely determine the answers you get.
author: Julie Gurner

text: If you always do what you’ve always done, you’ll always get what you’ve always got.
author: Jessie Potter

text: Your success... or mediocrity... or failure... is simply a reflection of your thinking.
author: Doug Firebaugh

text: Worry does not empty tomorrow of its sorrow, it empties today of its strength.
author: Corrie Ten Boom

text: Reading is to the mind what exercise is to the body and prayer is to the soul. We become the books we read.
author: Matthew Kelly

text: A positive attitude causes a chain reaction of positive thoughts, events and outcomes. It is a catalyst and it sparks extraordinary results.
author: attributed to Wade Boggs (unverified)

text: Love people, use things. The opposite never works.
author: Joshua Fields Millburn

text: Never offer what you'd hate someone for accepting.
author: Tara Ploughman

text: Tolerant with others, strict with yourself.
author: Marcus Aurelius

text: To achieve excellence, we must first understand the reality of every day, with all its demands and potential frustrations.
author: Mihaly Csikszentmihalyi

text: The journey is the reward
author: Steve Jobs

text: It is impossible to produce superior performance, unless you do something different from the majority.
author: Sir John Templeton
